title: Half Sugar's Gift News Test
subTitle: A sample announcement from Linghan Bingge
detail:
This is a sample announcement of Half Sugar's Gift, showing how the news panel works.

Edit the per-language file under Resources/News in the addon package to add entries. Fields:
· id: unique number for each entry
· title / shortTitle / subTitle: headline / list label / subtitle
· date: written as yyyy-MM-dd, the list is sorted by it in descending order
· detail: body text
· debug: set to true to show the entry only in debug mode

Body formatting
Use the br tag for line breaks; real newlines get eaten by the Json parser.
Use b and i for bold and italic.
Use the color tag, like this.
Links are written as bracket, url, bracket, visible text, then an empty bracket pair: [https://github.com/Half-Sugar-s-Gift/Half-Sugars-Gift]our repository[].
Avoid the size tag; vanilla swallows it along with the text inside.

Have fun! —— Linghan Bingge
